purpose: Independent per-code cross-check of the 676 distinct versioned ICD-10-CM codes in data/interop/condition_crosswalk.json against the FY2027 release, corroborating docs/audits/ICD_FY2027_INVENTORY_2026-10-22.md (which read the CDC/NCHS files).
not_canonical_source: NLM Clinical Tables is NOT on the COND_INGESTION_SPEC section 1 whitelist for ICD codes and descriptions. The canonical source is the CDC/NCHS FY2027 file read on 2026-10-22; this ledger is a second, independent source that must agree with it.
fy2027_detected_by: M72.2 is a billable code in FY2026; on 2026-10-28 the API no longer returns it and returns M72.20 / M72.21 / M72.22 instead, so the API was already serving FY2027.
method: one query per distinct code; billable_same_desc = the exact code is returned and its name equals our description byte-for-byte; not_billable_has_children = the exact code is absent but codes extending it are returned; absent = neither.
agreement_with_cdc_inventory: CDC inventory 2026-10-22: still_billable 675, header_code_claimed_billable 1 (M72.2), removed 0, description_drift 0. This ledger: billable_same_desc 675, not_billable_has_children 1 (M72.2), absent 0, billable_desc_differs 0.
